description.zh:
基础型全球加速实例的加速IP实例ID。
> **EndpointId**与**AccelerateIpId**不能同时为空。
description.en:
The accelerated IP address instance ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
> **EndpointId** and **AccelerateIpId** cannot both be empty.
The instance ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** value as the **ClientToken** value. The **RequestId** value of each API request is different.

description.zh:
基础型全球加速实例的终端节点ID。

> **EndpointId**与**AccelerateIpId**不能同时为空。
description.en:
The endpoint ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

> **EndpointId** and **AccelerateIpId** cannot both be empty.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.zh: 查询基础型全球加速实例的加速IP或终端节点的绑定信息
title.en: Query the attachment information of an accelerated IP address or endpoint of a basic global accelerator instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga get-basic-accelerate-ip-endpoint-relation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --endpoint-id ep-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --accelerate-ip-id gaip-bp10000 --region cn-hangzhou
